# Momentum Spine & Sports Physiotherapy

> > Edmonton-based physiotherapy clinic specializing in sports rehabilitation, injury treatment, and specialized musculoskeletal care with multiple clinic locations.

Momentum Spine & Sports Physiotherapy is a comprehensive physiotherapy practice in Edmonton, Alberta with clinics in Terwillegar and Windermere. The clinic offers specialized services ranging from sports rehabilitation and concussion management to pelvic floor therapy and cancer rehabilitation, with WCB approval and experienced physiotherapist staff.

## Key Topics

- Edmonton physiotherapy
- Sports rehabilitation
- Concussion management
- Motor vehicle accident (MVA) therapy
- Vestibular rehabilitation
- Pelvic floor physiotherapy
- Post-surgical rehabilitation
- Work injury (WCB)
- Joint replacement recovery
- Manual therapy
- Orthopedic rehabilitation
- Pain relief
- Injury treatment
- Terwillegar and Windermere locations

## Specialized Services

- [Services | Momentum Physiotherapy Clinic](https://www.mssphysio.com/physiotherapy-services-edmonton): Main services directory for Momentum Physiotherapy Edmonton treatments
- [Sports Physiotherapy Edmonton | Sports Rehabilitation Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/sports-physiotherapy-edmonton): Sports physiotherapy for injury recovery and athletic performance restoration
- [Concussion Physiotherapy Edmonton | Momentum Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/concussion-physiotherapy-edmonton): CCMI-certified concussion physiotherapy with assessment and guided recovery
- [Vestibular Physiotherapy Edmonton | Vestibular Rehab Therapy](https://www.mssphysio.com/vestibular-physiotherapy-edmonton): Vestibular physiotherapy for dizziness, vertigo, BPPV, and balance disorders
- [Pelvic Floor Physiotherapy Edmonton | Pelvic Health Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/pelvic-floor-physiotherapy-edmonton): Pelvic floor physiotherapy for core strength, bladder control, pelvic pain
- [Pre And Post Natal Physiotherapy Edmonton | Momentum Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/pre-and-post-natal-physiotherapy-edmonton): Pre and postnatal physiotherapy for pregnancy pain and postpartum recovery

## Injury & Accident Recovery

- [Motor Vehicle Accident Physiotherapy Edmonton | MVA Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/motor-vehicle-accident-physiotherapy-edmonton): MVA physiotherapy for whiplash, soft tissue injuries, and accident recovery
- [Work Injury Physiotherapy Edmonton | WCB Approved Clinic](https://www.mssphysio.com/work-injury-physiotherapy-edmonton-wcb): WCB-approved work injury physiotherapy for workplace accident recovery
- [Post Surgical Rehabilitation Therapy Edmonton Care](https://www.mssphysio.com/post-surgical-rehabilitation-therapy-edmonton): Post-surgical rehabilitation supporting healing and movement restoration
- [Pre Surgical Physiotherapy Edmonton | Momentum Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/pre-surgical-physiotherapy-edmonton): Pre-surgical physiotherapy preparing patients for orthopedic surgery recovery
- [Total Joint Replacement Physiotherapy Edmonton](https://www.mssphysio.com/total-joint-replacement-physiotherapy-edmonton): Joint replacement physiotherapy for hip, knee, shoulder surgery recovery

## Chronic Conditions & Rehabilitation

- [Fibromyalgia Physiotherapy Edmonton | Momentum Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/fibromyalgia-physiotherapy-edmonton): Fibromyalgia physiotherapy for chronic pain, fatigue, and daily function
- [Lymphedema Physiotherapy Edmonton | Momentum Physio](https://www.mssphysio.com/lymphedema-physiotherapy-edmonton): Lymphedema physiotherapy treating swelling, fluid retention, and mobility
- [Cancer Rehabilitation Physiotherapy Edmonton | Cancer Rehab](https://www.mssphysio.com/cancer-rehabilitation-physiotherapy-in-edmonton): Cancer rehabilitation physiotherapy for strength, fatigue, and recovery
- [Elbow Wrist And Hand Pain Physiotherapy Edmonton](https://www.mssphysio.com/elbow-wrist-and-hand-pain-physiotherapy-edmonton): Hand and wrist physiotherapy for carpal tunnel, sprains, and stiffness
